tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and screen background. Grid-paper pale in Day, deep navy in Night Shift. Ink, ink-muted and border read on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, part tiles, dialogs, buttons at rest. Ink and ink-muted read on it.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells behind gauges, inventory slots, input fields. Ink and ink-muted read on it.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: Decorative blueprint grid and hairlines only. Never carries meaning or text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and icons, and the 2px outline on chunky controls. Reads on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and every tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, units. Reads on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and every tint at 4.5:1 or better.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, slots and unselected controls. At least 3:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Gear Yellow. Primary action fill, Ground vehicle family, the player's own gear. Always outlined in ink; never used as text or as a bare shape on surface. Text on it is on-brand.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on brand fills.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Circuit Teal. Success, energy, Green Energy vehicle family, speed gauges. Also usable as text on surface-raised and teal-tint. Always paired with a check icon or the word for success.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on teal fills.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Bolt Blue. Information, hints, Air vehicle family, torque gauges. Usable as text on surface-raised and blue-tint.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on blue fills.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Rally Orange. Stalls, losses, warnings. Is a warm orange, never red, and always paired with an icon and a word. Usable as text on surface-raised and danger-tint.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on danger fills.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Highlight ground for tips and selected parts. Ink and ink-muted read on it.

tokens.name: teal-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for Concept Cards and success feedback. Ink and ink-muted read on it.

tokens.name: blue-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for hints. Ink and ink-muted read on it.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for loss explanations. Ink, ink-muted and danger read on it.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard, switch and controller focus ring: solid 3px, offset 2px. At least 3:1 on surface and surface-raised.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Title screen and race result headline. One per screen.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Instructions, explanations, hints. Default reading size; roughly grade 4 vocabulary.
styles.sample: A bigger gear turning a smaller gear spins the small one faster.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, tab labels, gauge names (set uppercase).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps inside cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, screen side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gaps.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target height and large gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Screen-level breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, gauge tracks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, part tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, cover tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, toggles.

shadow.note: Hard offset shadows, no blur: parts look like physical toys. A pressed control drops its shadow and moves down by its offset.

tokens.name: toy-shadow
tokens.usage: Buttons, part tiles, cards that can be picked up.

tokens.name: toy-shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the part being dragged.
